mapper.select: SELECT urd.required_doc_seq , urd.app_seq , urd.required_doc_name , vtdp."submitDeadline" , vtdp."signReqDate" , vtdp."receiptDate" , vtdp."sendDate" , vtdp."submitDate" FROM utb_required_document urd LEFT JOIN v_total_duedate_pivot vtdp ON urd.required_doc_seq = vtdp.tbl_seq WHERE urd.office_seq = #{officeSeq} AND urd.app_seq = #{appSeq} AND urd.required_doc_seq = #{requiredDocSeq} AND urd.del_yn = 'N'

SELECT urd.required_doc_seq , urd.required_doc_name , vtdp."submitDeadline" , vtdp."signReqDate" , vtdp."receiptDate" , vtdp."sendDate" , vtdp."submitDate" FROM utb_required_document urd LEFT JOIN v_total_duedate_pivot vtdp ON urd.required_doc_seq = vtdp.tbl_seq WHERE urd.office_seq = #{officeSeq} AND urd.app_seq = #{appSeq} AND urd.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY urd.create_at ASC
